props.name: children
props.description: Label or content shown inside the button.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the button. Use them to change size, colour or spacing.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called when the button is clicked or activated with the keyboard.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Set to true to stop clicks and dim the button.

props.name: type
props.description: Use "submit" inside a form to submit it.
